```{python}

# Load the datasets
continuous = pd.read_csv("data/continuous.csv")
binary = pd.read_csv("data/binary.csv")

# Merge the datasets on the State column
merged_data = pd.merge(continuous, binary, on='State', how='inner')

# Display the first few rows of the merged dataframe
print(merged_data.head())

# Save the merged data to a new CSV file
merged_data.to_csv("data/merged_data.csv", index=False)

print(f"Successfully merged datasets with {len(merged_data)} rows. Saved to 'data/merged_data.csv'")

```
